observation: The page opens with a solid red header bar holding a small GIF logo on the left and a single row of nav links on the right. The links are About Us and Flying with Us (both with dropdown carets), Quyana Rewards, Contact Us, Flight Schedule and the phone number.
evidence: Header is red (rgb(210,60,51)) at about 100px tall. Logo.gif is 83x59 natural size, shown at 80x57 at x=165. Tag counts: header 1, nav 1.

observation: The hero is a full-width dark photograph of carved Alaska Native owl and bird masks. The h1 and a white search card sit over it.
evidence: Hero spans roughly y=100–900 in slice 1. The h1 is white text over the photo.

observation: The h1 has two lines. 'GRANT AVIATION' is white and 'ALASKAN-OWNED AND OPERATED' is red, at 48px Raleway weight 400. The red line sits on a busy photo area and has low contrast.
evidence: facts h1: font_size 48px, weight 400, Raleway, color rgb(255,255,255). The h1 text contains a line break. Slice 1 shows the red second line over the cream and red carving.

observation: A white flight-search card sits in the hero, left of centre and offset from the page's centre line. It has no visible shadow. It holds a trip-type radio pair, two text inputs, two date inputs and three passenger steppers.
evidence: Card is about 808px wide at x=170–978. It contains Return Trip/One Way radios, Departing from/Traveling to, Departure/Return Date, and Adults/Children/Infants with − and + buttons. facts: 9 inputs, 2 selects, 1 form.

observation: The search card heading 'Search for Flights' is a 30px h2 in a light, dark-grey sans. Field labels are small, grey and regular weight. The 'Traveling to' label is greyed out because the field is disabled.
evidence: h2 font_size 30px, weight 400. 'Traveling to' label is visibly lighter in slice 1.

observation: The primary search button is flat and rectangular with a red fill and white text. It has square corners and fills about half the card width. Next to it, a small grey 'Agent Login »' link is right-aligned.
evidence: Red button 'Search for flights' at x≈197–557. Most elements have 0px radius: bucket_0 is 632 of about 641.

observation: The passenger steppers use a light-grey minus button and a white plus button either side of a centred number input. They are grouped in three columns with Bootstrap-style input groups.
evidence: Slice 1 shows Adults 1, Children 0, Infants 0 with − and + glyphs. Fonts include FontAwesome on 32 elements.

observation: The palette is mostly red, dark charcoal and white. Red (rgb(210,60,51)) is the accent on the header, buttons, icons, links and the large phone number. Dark backgrounds are rgb(34,34,34) and a blue-grey slate.
evidence: top_backgrounds: rgb(34,34,34) on 61 elements, rgb(210,60,51) on 6. top_text_colors: rgb(210,60,51) on 39 elements.

observation: Body text is mid-grey, with darker rgb(51,51,51) used for headings and labels. Body size is 16px with a 24px line height.
evidence: body_color rgb(114,114,114). body_font_size 16px. line_height 24px. top_text_colors includes rgb(51,51,51) on 130 elements.

observation: The type system pairs Open Sans for nearly all text with Raleway for the hero h1 and some headings. FontAwesome supplies icons. Several headings and footer titles fall back to a Helvetica or Arial-like face.
evidence: fonts_by_element_count: open sans 568, Raleway 38, FontAwesome 32, lucida grande 3.

observation: Below the hero there is a 'Welcome to Grant Aviation' module. A dark slate text panel on the left sits beside a white grid of 8 icon-link tiles in 4 columns × 2 rows. The module sits in a boxed container with side shadows over a dark band.
evidence: Slice 1: dark panel x=105–540, tiles x=540–1335. Tiles: Flight Schedule, Charters & Groups, Destinations, FAQs, Contact us, News, Freight & Cargo, Quyana Rewards.

observation: The tiles use red FontAwesome icons (calendar, plane, map pin, speech bubbles, paper plane, megaphone, briefcase, chart) with small dark labels. Thin hairline borders separate them. They are centred in each cell.
evidence: Slice 1 shows red glyphs over grey labels. i tag count 33.

observation: The welcome copy is a long COVID-19 notice set in bold white justified text. Each line has a black highlight behind the glyphs, which looks like a text-background effect on the dark slate panel. The justification leaves uneven word gaps.
evidence: Slice 1 and slice 2 show black bars behind each line, with 'COVID-19 Travel Updates...' in bold. A second, non-bold paragraph follows the same treatment.

observation: The welcome heading is uppercase, light-weight and white. A short red rule sits beneath it as an accent.
evidence: h2 'WELCOME TO GRANT AVIATION' with a red line at about y=1138.

observation: The dark panel is much taller than the tile grid. The slate background continues empty to the right of the tiles under the grid, leaving a large blank dark area.
evidence: Slice 2 shows the slate region from y≈85 to 412 with nothing to the right of the text.

observation: The page uses a central boxed container narrower than the 1440px viewport, with shadows on its left and right edges. Dark bands show at the edges behind the welcome and footer areas.

observation: The charter and communities section uses two columns. Charter text on the left has a 'Keep reading…' red link and an embedded black video frame with a play button. A two-column list of red-pin destinations sits on the right.

observation: The video embed shows only a black rectangle with a central play button and no poster image. The right column is shorter than the left, leaving empty white space beside the video.
evidence: Slice 2 shows a black 555×312 block. The destinations list ends near y=692.

observation: The destinations list is a plain 2-column list of 8 towns, each with a red map-pin icon: Anchorage, Bethel, Cold Bay, Dillingham, Dutch Harbor, Emmonak, Kenai and King Salmon. A red text link follows it.

evidence: Slices 2–3: band bg is light grey-blue. The phone text is about 56px red. The h2 reads 'Make a Reservation Today! 888-Fly-Grant or 888-359-4726'. The button has a slight shadow.

observation: The photo strip has six small thumbnails with white borders and a slight padding frame, in a single row, plus a red 'More photos' button below. The images are low-resolution, with natural size 76×67 shown at 67×59.

evidence: Slice 4 shows a bar at about 113px high, with a darker bg than the footer body.

observation: The layout relies on legacy float and grid systems rather than modern CSS layout. There is no CSS grid or flexbox, and the class vocabulary is Bootstrap-like but not utility-based.
evidence: display_grid 0, display_flex 0. Classes: 598 total, 153 unique, tailwind_like_fraction 0.015.

observation: The DOM is div- and span-heavy, with only one section element and no main, article or aside. There are 128 divs, 144 spans and 116 anchors. Landmarks are limited to one header, one nav and one footer.
evidence: semantic: main 0, section 1, article 0, aside 0, header 1, nav 1, footer 1.

observation: The heading structure is a single h1 followed by a mix of h2s and h3s. h2 is used for several section titles, and h3 for the sub-blocks and all footer column titles. The page has 15 h5 elements, and the counts are inconsistent with the visible levels.
evidence: h1_count 1, h2 5, h3 10, h5 15. The outline goes h1 → h2 → h2 → h3 → h3 → h2 → h3…

observation: The page is heavy on scripts and assets for its content size. It has 34 script tags, 23 link tags and 18 stylesheets, plus a base element and 25 inline style attributes.
evidence: tag_counts script 34, link 23, base 1. counts: stylesheets 18, inline_style_attrs 25.

observation: ARIA use is extensive for a legacy template, with 125 aria attributes. The page also holds 61 option elements, with 2 selects hidden behind the location pickers.
evidence: counts aria_attrs 125. tag_counts option 61, select 2. The 'Select a location...' primary_button reports white text on a white background.

observation: Decoration is restrained. There are 4 gradient backgrounds, 9 shadows and 58 transitions. Only 2 elements use pill radii and 7 use small radii. The look is flat with sharp corners.
evidence: effects: gradient_backgrounds 4, box_shadows 9, transitions 58, transforms 29, animations 0, backdrop_blur 0. bucket_0 632, bucket_1_7 7, bucket_pill 2.

observation: Copy is functional and corporate, with an Alaskan regional flavour. It includes 'Quyana Rewards', named Alaska communities and the phone mnemonic '888-Fly-Grant'. The page has about 481 words, 2 exclamation marks and no emoji or em dashes.
evidence: text_stats: words 481, emoji 0, em_dashes 0, exclamations 2.

observation: Capitalisation varies by component. Nav and search labels use sentence or title case, the radio labels are all caps, and the welcome and footer headings are uppercase. The news title is uppercase and larger than the other card text.
evidence: 'RETURN TRIP', 'ONE WAY', 'WELCOME TO GRANT AVIATION', 'LEGAL', 'FOLLOW US'. h2 'GRANT AVIATION SUMMER NEWSLETTER 2018'.

observation: Small icons sit in front of nav labels (paper plane, calendar, phone) from the FontAwesome icon font rather than SVG. The page has no SVG elements.
